_readme: Written by scripts/gen-concept-cars.py; read by the asset gallery.

models.name: concept-buggy
models.note: RC off-road buggy: cab-forward shell, roll cage, open engine and knobby tyres, with the wing, round lamps and nose louvres.

models.name: concept-rally
models.note: Rally hatch: boxy shell with flared arches, with a roof spoiler, two driving lamps on the bumper, a bonnet scoop and a grille.

models.name: concept-gt
models.note: Le Mans GT: long low wedge, tinted bubble cockpit over fender humps, with a full-width wing, fender lamps, tail lamps and bonnet louvres.

models.name: concept-pip
models.note: Bubble micro car: short rounded shell, glass bubble with a painted cap and chrome bumpers, with frog-eye lamps, a lip spoiler and bonnet louvres.

models.name: dash-plus
models.note: Dash with a touch more: a slatted rear screen, tail lamps above the bumper, square lamps, a grille, a bonnet scoop.

models.name: bolt-plus
models.note: Bolt with a touch more: endplates on the front wing, louvres on the nose and the airbox, tail lamps in a dark panel.

models.name: carve-plus
models.note: Carve with a touch more: twin round lamps at both ends, the tail's in a dark panel, a grille, louvres on the bonnet and the roof, a rear screen.

models.name: rumble-plus
models.note: Rumble with a touch more: round lamps and a grille in the bonnet's face, louvres on the bonnet and the tail deck, tail lamps.
